comment: Leu is by no means an awful professor, but she is not great either. Each class period is taken up by fully by lecture over dry material, but she is able to get the point across well. If you listen in class and read a little outside, an A is definitely possible. She can sometimes be a little hard to understand and follow.

Dr. Leu is the holistically worst professor I have taken in my academic career. Her ability to be organized or instructive is grossly poor. From being convoluted in her guidelines to inaccessible via email, she makes it difficult to do well. Although there's little work,  getting an A is a result of arbitrary factors that you can't always control.

I love political science and this class was my least favorite of the semester. She's hard to understand, puts all of the notes on the screen but moves way too quickly. Never really able to follow what she is saying which makes the papers difficult to write. Midterm and final - she provides a very long and repetitive study guide but test was easy
